answer_1.quote: This work introduced a novel task of event-centric news cluster summarization... We propose CLUST-MCMS, a novel two-stage pipeline for event-centric news clustering (ENC) followed by news cluster summarization...

answer_2.quote: We evaluate MCMS using three metrics: ROUGE... Event Coverage (Eve-Cov)... Entity Faithfulness (Ent-Faith)... For CLUST-MCMS we introduce CLUST-ROUGE... We also report Normalized Mutual Information (NMI) for clustering.

answer_3.quote: We employ GPT4o to identify event sentences related to manually identified ME for each article... we conduct a manual evaluation of Eve-Cov, comparing the agreements among human annotators, GPT4o evaluation, and our proposed Eve-Cov metric.
methods: event sentence identification for coverage metric

answer_4.quote: We manually evaluate how well each summary covers the aspects, assigning a score from 0 to 5 for each aspect... Human agreement... we conduct a manual evaluation of Eve-Cov, comparing the agreements among human annotators...
answer_4.guideline: Assign a score from 0 to 5 for each aspect to assess coverage and faithfulness of the generated summary.
